instruction: A candid documentary medium shot captures a lively backyard party. On the left, the man in the patterned shirt (R3) is blindfolded with a peach bandana, swinging a yellow bat upward with both hands. On the right, the woman in the pink shirt (R1) stands slightly behind him, smiling and watching his swing. The background features lush green foliage under soft, natural daylight. The interaction is playful, with the woman cheering the blindfolded man as he attempts to hit a piñata.
